title: 90 Minute Miami Everglades Semi Private Airboat Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Designed for smaller groups who want to skip the crowds, this Miami Everglades airboat ride balances a private feel with an affordable shared adventure. You’ll ride with only 7 guests total, ensuring plenty of space, comfort, and clear views of Everglades flora and fauna.

Enjoy an authentic, educational, and thrilling ride led by knowledgeable native Gladesmen who are also professional USCG captains & FWC certified airboat operators. Safety and your Everglades experience are our top priority at the River of Grass.

Our state of the art airboats have cushioned tiered seats for great views of the Everglades famous fresh water grasslands. Your Captains will stop throughout the tour to showcase wild alligators, birds and unique flora all within the natural habitat. Never any caged wildlife! Learn about the history and ongoing restoration efforts of this fragile ecosystem while enjoying a personal experience in a magical wilderness.
